papers.title: SearchOS-V1: Towards Robust Open-Domain Information-Seeking Agent Collaboration
papers.what: A multi-agent search framework that externalizes progress into an Evidence Graph, Coverage Map, and Failure Memory, then schedules sub-agents against uncovered gaps so failed search patterns are not repeated.

papers.title: BadWAM: When World-Action Models Dream Right but Act Wrong
papers.what: Defines World-Action Drift Attacks in which small visual perturbations desynchronize a world-action model's imagined future from its executed action, dropping one task's success from 96.5% to 43.1% while an imagination-preserving variant keeps the forecast looking clean.
papers.builds_on: World Models (Ha & Schmidhuber 2018); Navigation World Models; From Pixels to States (Li 2026)

papers.title: RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies
papers.what: Puts Test-Time Training inside a Vision-Language-Action policy so fast weights hold 8,000 timesteps of history at flat latency, improving performance 87% over a single-step baseline and completing a ten-stage assembly task no baseline finishes.

papers.title: UniVR: Thinking in Visual Space for Unified Visual Reasoning
papers.what: Learns reasoning, physical dynamics, and planning from pure visual demonstrations using VR-GRPO, a reinforcement learning scheme with a global answer reward plus a step-level physical-consistency reward, giving up to 25% gains on the new VR-X benchmark.
